_about: The on-device models the app ships, mirrored to the corpus bucket under models/<id>/ by scripts/corpus-sync.py (push --models, pull --models <id>|all). docs/EXTRACTION.md -> 'Model registry' is the human-readable table; this file is its machine-readable twin - a row that ships or replaces a model updates both. Refused, retired and spike candidates are not listed (product owner, 2026-10-01); corpus-sync only uploads, so anything pushed before stays in the bucket and pull --models <id> restores it. Paths are repository-relative; .out/ paths are gitignored and live only in the bucket and on the machine that trained them.

models.role: cell classifier: 7 segments + dp over a 32x48 crop
models.trainedOn: synthetic renders + 30 % real glyphs (25 085 cells), 15 000 steps
models.benchmark: heldout annotated 126/126; live 62/61 with rowseg-seg-r1 (47/47 with digitrows-pu33); dp AUC 0.653; 24 328 params, 64 KB

models.role: row locator: PixelLink pixel + link segmenter, oriented quads
models.trainedOn: 256 train stills + 275 owner-verified frames + 116 negatives, hand quads; 30 000 steps
models.benchmark: rotated gate median IoU 0.861, recall@0.7 0.885, false rows/photo 0.088, 65/68 photos every row; 26.5-29.8 ms Mac Release; 0.91 M params, 1.8 MB

models.role: row reader: CRNN + CTC over a 32 px strip, reads a whole number window as a sequence (Core ML, float32, flexible width)
models.trainedOn: PU.91 experiment Gv, seed 0: 73 384 real strips (58 399 after the per-source cap) - the full hand export (stills and video frames) plus 16 542 strips cut from the locator's own boxes at the standard and wide margins - half the real strips shifted up or down by up to 10 % of their height (--vshift 0.1); best train-side validation checkpoint (string 0.899); exported by pump_reader.rowexport
models.benchmark: iOS 27 simulator with the second read (PU.108): live 145 committed / 144 correct (0.993), annotated 154 / 154, 49 / 68 photos every field, pump composite 150 / 186; macOS live 143 / 143
